title: Design question: one agent's missing config fails the whole build in agents schedules
description: agents schedules refuses to reconcile any schedule when one agent (rate on Machines on Machines) names a publication with no siteBucket, exits 2 and fails the entire Amplify build, including the frontend. Decide whether it should skip and report the one agent, or keep refusing. Found 2026-11-17 during the 5.130.3 bump (job failed at the schedules step; rate was disabled and the build retried green). Related: PPY-e713eb, PPY-d85860.
